sourceOfRecord.policy: verbatim upstream measurement is the reference; this model is a runtime reduction and never replaces it

blackPolicy.description: Use the dedicated Summary Black spectrum as global absolute black; subtract each ramp's own first reading before combining it so measured series drift remains auditable without contaminating response amplitude.

interactionPolicy.description: Use black-aligned R/G/B ramps, measured Y/C/M diagonal residuals extended by geometric-mean pair coordinates, and the measured Greyscale residual extended by the geometric-mean triple coordinate; then project the derived 32-cubed luminance field onto the three axis-wise isotonic cones.

candidates.role: Y/C/M constrained candidate with Greyscale held out
analytic seed candidate using every measured ramp
released LUT after explicit 3D luminance projection of pairwise-neutral
exact pinned upstream equation comparison; omits measured black
fair absolute-reflectance comparison after mapping upstream normalized white and adding measured black

normalization.codeMappingPolicy: identity for 32-reading ramps; endpoint-preserving uniform source-index resampling for R=31 and G=33
normalization.monotonicPolicy: PAVA projection of each black-subtracted measured ramp, then Dykstra projection of the derived 32-cubed Y field onto all three axis-wise isotonic cones; XYZ direction relative to black is scaled per voxel and raw values remain untouched

limitations: The accepted source contains invalid short wavelengths, negative reflectance, black drift, R/G patch-count mismatch, and unrecorded measurement conditions.
Only seven one-dimensional RGB axes/diagonals are measured; arbitrary mixed colors use a declared geometric-mean interaction extension.
The project monotonic model is a transparent runtime reduction; the verbatim ODS/TXT remain the reference of record.
The result applies only to the frozen D65 45 degree illumination and 0 degree panel-normal viewing condition.
